_comment: BRYME Articles — section configuration. Everything a story does NOT carry itself lives here: the category system, the featured slot and the editorial invitation's behaviour. Edit by hand; the build validates every value and refuses to publish a section it cannot render honestly.
intro: Discover fascinating stories about people, life, society, money, ambition and the world around us. Stories worth your time, questions worth exploring, and perspectives you may not have considered.

categories.name: Living in Africa
categories.blurb: Cities, money, family, work and the texture of ordinary days across the continent — reported from where people actually live.

categories.name: Lives and Lifestyles
categories.blurb: How people organise their days, their money and their ambitions — from the night shift to the family business.

categories.name: Money and Ambition
categories.blurb: What people earn, what they are chasing and what it costs them — the everyday economics of wanting more.

categories.name: Human Behaviour
categories.blurb: Why we do the things we do: decisions, habits, risk, luck and the stories we tell ourselves to keep going.

categories.name: Unusual Jobs and Hidden Worlds
